description: Use case: unique keys that identify exactly one item worldwide, so that the item can be found in other systems by its key. Each key word has the phrase type unique key and each sample key is linked to its key word with 'is a' and to the item it identifies with 'is symbol for'. The ISBN-13 of a book is also the EAN of the book, so one sample shows both forms.

words.name: ISBN
words.description: International Standard Book Number: identifies one edition of a book; since 2007 it has 13 digits and equals the EAN of the book with the prefix 978 or 979

words.name: ISIN
words.description: International Securities Identification Number (ISO 6166): identifies one security with 12 characters, the country code, the nine character national number and a check digit

words.name: EAN
words.description: European Article Number: the 13 digit barcode number of a retail product, today named International Article Number (IAN)

words.name: IAN
words.description: International Article Number: the current name of the EAN, so an IAN and an EAN are the same number

words.name: UPC
words.description: Universal Product Code: the 12 digit barcode number of a retail product used mainly in North America, which is an EAN with a leading zero

words.name: JAN
words.description: Japanese Article Number: the EAN of a product registered in Japan, which starts with the prefix 45 or 49

words.name: The Myth of Sisyphus
words.description: the essay by Albert Camus, first published in French in 1942, here in its English translation

words.name: Rhinoceros and Other Plays
words.description: the book of Grove Press with the play Rhinoceros by Eugène Ionesco in the English translation of Derek Prouse

words.name: A Theory of Justice, revised edition
words.description: the revised edition of 1999 of the book by John Rawls, first published by the Belknap Press of Harvard University Press in 1971

words.name: Mercedes-Benz Group share
words.description: the registered share of Mercedes-Benz Group AG

words.name: Nestlé registered share
words.description: the registered share of Nestlé S.A.
